prompts.prompt: Create a todo list app with add, delete, and mark complete functionality
Task list where I can add tasks, with a search box that filters as you type
Team kanban board with todo, doing, and done columns. Cards have a title and an owner. Buttons to move cards between columns and to delete them. Show a count per column. Dark theme.
Contact manager: add contacts with name, company, and email. Click a contact in the list to see a detail panel with all fields and a delete button. Show how many contacts exist.
Inventory tracker: add items with a name, quantity, and unit price. List them with a delete button per row. Dashboard section showing total item count, total stock value, and the average unit price.
A calculator where I type an expression and press a button to evaluate it
BMI calculator with weight in kilograms and height in meters
Stopwatch with start, stop, and reset, showing elapsed seconds
Daily journal: a text area for the entry, save button, entries listed with their date, newest first
Expense tracker with a category dropdown (food, travel, other), the list filterable by category, and a total for the visible entries
